text:
**Short answer:** For most people, get the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**. If you have a recent iPhone and want 25W, the **ESR CryoBoost** is the best value.

**My picks**

1. **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick. It lists at $109, with $98 shown at WIRED and $80 at Best Buy. It charges the iPhone at 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy, and there's a 2-year warranty. [Details and buy links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

2. **Best value for fast charging: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W).** It has a built-in cooling fan and a 50W adapter. WIRED notes the fan can be switched off for sleeping. It folds, so it travels well, but the plastic build isn't premium. The list price is $99.99, and Dealectric reports code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off in ESR's cart on Oct 23, for about $82. [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. The store's checkout has the final word on the code. 
   - 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other recent models get 20W, and older ones get 15W.
   - Warranty is 12 months (24 with registration) per Dealectric, but WIRED lists 2 years.

3. **Fastest and most premium: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It gives 25W to the iPhone and has an angled pad. No power adapter is included, so you'll need a 40W one. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

4. **Best flat, out-of-sight design: Nimble Podium, about $130.** It supports 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

5. **Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W).** WIRED lists it at about $40 on Amazon, down from $80. The Watch charger is a detachable unit and the warranty is only 1 year. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Desk and travel option:** The **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W)**, $129.99, is the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested. It includes a 45W adapter. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Is 25W worth paying for?** If you charge overnight, probably not. WIRED says 25W makes little difference for overnight charging. It matters if you often top up quickly during the day and have a supported iPhone.

Which iPhone do you have? That would settle whether the 25W models are worth the extra money.
